cases.prompt: Use pr-fix on the review feedback in review-comments.md for cart.py. Work from these local files instead of GitHub (no gh, no network). Do not commit or push.
expected_behavior: Shows a numbered fix plan listing the comments before editing cart.py
Applies each fix separately and runs a verification command (e.g. python -m py_compile cart.py) after each one before starting the next
Changes only what each comment asks for; cart_total and unrelated lines are not refactored or renamed

check.cmd: python3 -m py_compile cart.py && python3 -c "import cart; assert cart.apply_discount(100, 10) == 90"

cases.prompt: Use pr-fix to handle the comments in review-comments.md against cart.py. Work only from these local files, not GitHub. Don't commit or push. Finish with your usual report.
expected_behavior: Final report starts a section with the heading '## PR Fix Summary'
Contains a '**Fixed**: N of M comments' line with M equal to 3, and a '**Skipped**' line with a count
Contains a 'Changes made' table (# | File | Comment | Status) and a 'Skipped' table (# | File | Comment | Reason)
Ends with a '### Verification' list reporting the type check or compile result and the tests result

check.cmd: grep -q '## PR Fix Summary' output.txt && grep -qi 'Fixed.*of 3' output.txt && grep -q '### Verification' output.txt

cases.prompt: Go through review-comments.md and fix cart.py accordingly with pr-fix. Use only these local files, not GitHub. Don't commit or push.
expected_behavior: Does not remove the round(...) call from cart_total
Lists comment 2 (id 9002) as skipped or pushed back on, with a stated reason that round(x, 2) works on floats
Still fixes the valid comments (percent divided by 100, and the ValueError range check)

check.cmd: grep -q 'round(' cart.py && python3 -c "import cart; assert cart.apply_discount(200, 50) == 100"

cases.prompt: Apply the valid review comments in review-comments.md to cart.py using pr-fix. Local files only, no GitHub. Then tell me what to do next.
expected_behavior: Leaves the changes uncommitted and does not run git commit or git push
Tells the user the changes are left for them to review and commit
